set.body:
Scope
Replace implicit unbalanced mass scaling with explicit coverage and normalized correspondence.

Acceptance criteria
- Optimize explicit M and unit-mass Gamma, or an equivalent fixed-mass profile; no division-by-M singularity is present.
- Source and target partial marginals are dominated by the original duration masses, or an alternative selection divergence is justified and tested.
- Spatial and temporal fidelity are conditional on selected mass and share a declared homogeneity.
- Coverage, selection, and coupling regularization have separate documented meanings.
- Correspondence regularization is refinement-aware and documented as numerical regularization, not psychological uncertainty.
- Fixed-mass coverage-fidelity curves and a scalar cross-fitted coverage policy are retained.
- Solver continuation, common initialization, candidate-order invariance, stationarity diagnostics, and finite-difference gradient tests pass.
- Public diagnostics include coverage, native-unit spatial residual, bounded local-order residual, warp, rank, and alignment stability.
set.title: GW-2 Implement coverage-conditioned Transport v2
